cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(waybill_fixture_ctl)
find_package(waybill_fixture_a)
find_package(waybill_fixture_b 2.1)
find_package(waybill_fixture_c 3.0 EXACT)
find_package(Waybill_Fixture_Mixed 1.0 REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(WFPC REQUIRED waybill-fixture-pc>=1.0)
include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(waybill_fixture_dep GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/waybill-fixture/dep.git GIT_TAG v1.2.3)
